evidence.detail: R357 LauncherSidePanel installs rs/gui/G as the exact tab labeled 'Item Search' when developer UI is not enabled and constrains it to the side-panel 344x480 surface.

The panel owns the search text field, Search button, scrollable result area and item-search result rendering logic; R301 independently recovered its text-field and button listeners as ItemSearchEnterAction and ItemSearchButtonAction.
R301 proves both rs/gui/H and rs/gui/I dispatch directly into this panel's private search routine, fixing G as the parent item-search surface rather than a generic list panel.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the item-search tab surface in LauncherSidePanel.
